id: title:Gilbert09:stop exhausted connection retries reporting as error tracking noise

review.posthog_relevance: Adds ReadTimeout to transient, self-recovering errors for Notion warehouse ingestion, allowing Temporal to retry instead of recording permanent failure.
review.reason: The implementation hunk P1.F1.H1 explicitly adds 'ReadTimeout' alongside existing transient errors (5xx, connection-reset) in the retryable error set. This allows the Notion warehouse ingestion workflow to recover from transient network timeouts rather than failing permanently, provided the retry budget is exhausted. The accompanying test hunk P1.F2.H1 validates this behavior. This
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the frequency and recoverability of ReadTimeouts in Notion ingestion, which is not demonstrated by the code alone; this is a bounded reliability improvement rather than a systemic capability expansion.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains two hunks. P1.F1.H1 is a production implementation change. P1.F2.H1 is a test change. The implementation and test are tightly coupled, supporting a single change group. No unrelated PRs are indicated.

observations.behavior: Refined the set of transient, self-recovering errors returned by get_retryable_errors to include ReadTimeout alongside existing 5xx and connection-reset cases.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the Notion warehouse ingestion activity to be retried by Temporal rather than being recorded as a permanent failure when the underlying HTTP request times out or encounters a transient SSL read error, provided the tenacity retry budget is exhausted.
